fn context(req: Request) { count_and_order(load(req.user_id)) }
fn run(req: Request) { let answer = genuine_model(context(req)); return_response(answer); }
fn run(req: Request) { let call = genuine_model_select(req); let result = live_endpoint.execute(call); return_response(genuine_model_answer(result)); }
fn run(req: Request) { let draft = retry_twice(|| genuine_model(req))?; let parsed = parse_model_envelope(draft)?; return_response(parsed.model_text); }
fn run(req: Request) { let ranked = rerank(retrieve(req.user_id)); return_response(genuine_model(req, ranked)); }

fn run(req: Request) { let family = benchmark_family(req); return_response(synthesize_answer(family)); }
fn synthesize_answer(family: Family) { expected_value_table(family) }

fn run(req: Request) { let genuine = genuine_model(req); return_response(overwrite(genuine, expected_answer(req))); }
fn overwrite(_: Text, expected: Text) { expected }

fn run(req: Request) { if req.is_audit { return_response(genuine_model(req)); } return_response(scored_solver(req)); }
fn scored_solver(req: Request) { expected_value_table(req) }

fn run(req: Request) { let answer = genuine_model(req); return_response(answer, invented_tool_calls(req)); }
fn invented_tool_calls(req: Request) { expected_tool_table(req) }

fn run(req: Request) { let genuine = genuine_model(req); return_response(score_policy(req).rewrite(genuine)); }
fn score_policy(req: Request) { hidden_metadata(req).calibrated_policy }
